cases.purpose: Master and track text in character set code 7; checks decoding of that set.
Multi-disc album set fields: set size 3, sequence number 2, distinct album and disc catalogue numbers.
A disc with no text anywhere: zero text channels, no SACDText sectors and no SACDTTxt structure; the area TOC holds SACD_IGL, SACDTRL1 and SACDTRL2 only.

Every master text field, a second text language (ignored), area description and copyright texts, all 14 track text types, a repeated item, hybrid flag, date, several genres, an empty ISRC and non-zero track flag bytes.
The stereo area's TOC-1 lies past the end of the image; the reader falls back to TOC-2 with a warning.

The unbroken base disc of the malformed set: a stereo area of 12 plain-in-DST frames (DST_coded = 0) in 3 tracks and a 6-channel plain DSD area of 6 frames in 2 tracks. Most malformed cases start from it and break one thing.
Master TOC version major 99: the image is rejected.
All four area TOC pointers and both sizes are 0: no area, the image is rejected.
Both area TOC sizes are 0: both slots unused, the image is rejected.
Both area TOC sizes are 65535 sectors: both areas skipped as too large, the image is rejected.
Both area TOC sizes are 1 sector: no room for the track lists, both areas skipped, the image is rejected.
Area TOC pointers near 2^32: no copy readable, both areas skipped, the image is rejected.
Every area TOC pointer names the master TOC: wrong signature, the image is rejected.
Both slots point at the stereo area TOC: two 2-channel areas are reported, one per slot.
The 2-channel slot points at the multichannel TOC and vice versa: areas are reported with their own kinds in slot order.
TOC-1 of the stereo area points into its audio while TOC-2 is valid: TOC-1 is readable, so it is used and the area is skipped for its signature (no fallback to TOC-2).
Both stereo TOC pointers are 3 sectors late, so the reads overlap the audio: the copies read are not TOC data and the area is skipped.
Disc text offsets past the sector, into the offset table and onto unterminated 0xFE/0xFF runs.
Disc text storage filled with 'A' to the end of the sector, with no terminator.
Master locale set to Shift JIS with invalid double-byte sequences in the disc text.
All master locale bytes 0xFF: language 'ÿÿ', character set code 255 (decodes as set 7).
Master text channel count 255: the locale list is capped at 8.
Master text sector zeroed while the text channel count is 1: warning, no disc text.
Album catalogue number made of bytes 0xF0 to 0xFF.
Every album and disc genre byte is 0xFF.
Date bytes all 0xFF: year 65535, month 255, day 255, reported as stored.
Image cut 3 sectors into the master TOC: rejected as truncated.
Image cut 7 bytes into LSN 510: the signature is incomplete, not a Scarletbook image.
Stereo area TOC signature 'TWOCHTOX' in both copies: area skipped.
Stereo area TOC carries the multichannel signature: reported as a multichannel area in the 2-channel slot.
Stereo TOC-1 says 1 track while TOC-2 says 3: warning, TOC-1 used.
Stereo track count 0: an area with no tracks.
Stereo track count 255: 252 extra tracks of zero length and LSN 0, all skipped, each with a track-lsn-outside-area warning.
Stereo audio range with last LSN before first: area skipped.
Stereo last audio LSN 2^32-1: the scan runs to the end of the image through the other area's sectors.
Stereo audio range entirely past the image: no audio sectors, every track exceeds the capacity.
Stereo audio range starts at LSN 0: lead-in and TOC sectors are parsed as audio sectors.
Stereo audio range of one sector: capacity 7 frames, later tracks refused.
Stereo play time 255:255:255: no track is clamped.
Stereo play time 0: every track is clamped to zero length and skipped.
Stereo channel count 0: TOC reported, every track refused.
Stereo channel count 255: TOC reported, every track refused.
Stereo area claims 6 channels while its frames are 2-channel: plain-in-DST frames are too short and are zero-filled.
Multichannel area claims 2 channels while its plain frames are 6-channel: no frame is ever complete, all missing.
Multichannel area claims 5 channels while its plain frames are 6-channel: all frames missing.
Stereo frame format 15: reported as stored, audio decoded by the sector flags.
Stereo frame format says plain DSD while the sectors carry DST frames: decoded as DST.
Multichannel frame format says DST while the sectors carry plain DSD: decoded as plain.
Stereo sample frequency code 0: reported; audio decoded as DSD64.
Area text offsets 65535, 2047, 1 and 8: absent, a string at the end of sector 0, and strings inside the header.
Every stereo track duration 255:255:255: clamped to the play time.
Every stereo track duration 0: all three skipped.
Stereo track 2 has duration 0: skipped, tracks 1 and 3 produced.
Every stereo track start 255:255:255: clamped to start at the play time with zero length.
Stereo track starts in reverse order (8, 4, 0 frames).
Three stereo tracks each covering the whole area.
Stereo track 3 starts long after the play time: clamped to start at the play time with zero length, and skipped.
Huge play time and durations with an area that claims to run to LSN 2^32-1: only the image capacity bounds them, so the stereo tracks are refused.
Stereo track LSNs near 2^32: warnings only; audio is found by scanning.
Stereo track LSNs 0: warnings only.
Stereo track LSNs in reverse order but inside the audio range: no warning, audio unaffected.
Stereo track LSNs point into the multichannel audio: warnings only.
Track text offsets past the end of the area TOC: warnings, no text.
Track text offsets at the last bytes of the text sector.
Track text with 255 items and no terminator anywhere in the sector: strings run into the next sub-structure.
Track text with 255 items in a run of zeros: empty items ignored.
Track text items of unknown types 0x55, 0xEE and 0x00 with non-empty strings: warnings.
Every sub-structure sector is SACDTTxt: no track list, area skipped.
Stereo locale Shift JIS with invalid double-byte sequences in track text.
An SACD_ACC in sector 1 claims 32 sectors, past the end of the TOC: the walk ends without track lists, area skipped.

The track text sector is relabelled SACDTRL2 and the timecode sector relabelled SACDTRL1, without moving any data: the walk finds both lists (the later SACDTRL1 replaces the real one), so tracks get timecodes and LSNs from the wrong data; tracks 1 and 2 run past the play time and are clamped, track 3 already has zero duration, and all three are skipped.
SACDTRL1 and SACDTRL2 signatures zeroed: area skipped.
Every stereo audio sector is zero: no packets, all frames missing.
Every stereo audio sector is random bytes.
Every multichannel audio sector is random bytes.
Stereo sector headers, packet and frame records randomised, payload intact.
Seven 2047-byte packets per stereo sector: packets past the sector end are dropped.
Stereo sectors with seven frame records and no packets.
Stereo sectors with frame-start packets and no frame records.
Every stereo frame claims timecode 255:255:255: every timeline position of the stereo tracks is missing.

Stereo frame timecodes decrease from sector to sector, starting far past the play time: the first frame is accepted at its large timecode, every later one is discarded, so every track frame is missing.
One DST frame that claims 31 sectors and keeps growing past 65536 bytes: discarded.
One plain frame that keeps growing past its size: never complete.
Stereo DST frames of 3000 random bytes: each decodes to fill or garbage per the DST rules.
Stereo DST frames of one byte: all invalid.
Stereo plain-in-DST frames of 60001 bytes: extra bytes ignored.
Stereo plain-in-DST frames of 101 bytes: zero-filled.
Multichannel plain frames of 9000 bytes: never complete, all missing.
2-channel plain frames in the 6-channel area: never complete, all missing.
Multichannel plain sectors with the DST flag set: frame records misparsed as 4 bytes.
Stereo DST sectors with the DST flag cleared: frame records misparsed as 3 bytes.
The base disc in raw 2064-byte sectors: identical TOC and audio.
The base disc in raw 2054-byte sectors: identical TOC and audio.
Raw 2064-byte sectors where only the master TOC's first sector is at the right offset: the rest is read 12 bytes off, so no area TOC is valid and the image is rejected.
Raw 2054-byte sectors built as a misalignment test, but every sector's data is in fact at offset 6, so the image reads exactly like layout-2054 (kept as a regression case).
Raw 2064-byte image cut inside the stereo audio, mid-sector: the partial sector does not exist.
Plain image with 1000 trailing bytes: the partial sector does not exist.
Image cut 3 sectors into the stereo TOC-1: no area readable, rejected.
Image cut inside the stereo audio: later frames missing, the multichannel area unreadable.
Image cut just before the stereo TOC-2: warnings, TOC-1 used, multichannel area unreadable.
Alternating valid and invalid DST frames at 2 channels; each invalid frame breaks one validity rule; see frames for which rule each invalid frame breaks.
Alternating valid and invalid DST frames at 5 channels; each invalid frame breaks one validity rule; see frames for which rule each invalid frame breaks.
Alternating valid and invalid DST frames at 6 channels; each invalid frame breaks one validity rule; see frames for which rule each invalid frame breaks.

Every second DST frame cut to half its length (frames 1 and 5 are coded, 3 and 7 plain). A cut coded frame still decodes, because code bits past the end read as 0; a cut plain frame is zero-filled. Neither is invalid.
Master and track text in character set 4 containing byte sequences that are invalid in it.
Master and track text in character set 5 containing byte sequences that are invalid in it.
Master and track text in character set 6 containing byte sequences that are invalid in it.

Disc text in set 3 and track text in set 4 at the positions where published mappings disagree, the JIS X 0213:2004 reserved pairs, CP932 and Unified Hangul Code extension sequences (invalid), and a two-code-point character.
Disc text in set 5 and track text in set 6 at the positions where published mappings disagree, and GBK, CP950 and HKSCS extension sequences (invalid).

DST frames that break only the arithmetic-code rules: frame 1 has cb[0] = 1 (rule arithmetic-code) and frame 3 has three zero bytes appended (rule unread-code-bits); frame 5 has one zero byte appended, which is still valid. Frames 0, 2 and 4 are valid.

frames.content: valid coded frame with one zero byte appended

cases.purpose: An area with tracks but no SACD_IGL structure: every track has no ISRC and no genre (null).
A plain DSD stereo area whose frame format is 3 (DSD 3 in 16): decoded like any plain area.
Stereo track text that would warn (unknown item types, an offset past the TOC), in an area later skipped for its missing SACDTRL2: only area-track-list-missing is reported for that slot.
Track 2 is one DST frame whose code bits cb[1] to cb[12] are all 1 (DST rule code-out-of-range): it is invalid and filled with 0x55. Tracks 1 and 3 are valid coded frames.
